title: On what is essential to baptism the Lutherans and Reformed already agree; the leftover quarrel is slight
pass_a_gloss: The consensus of the Lutherans with the Reformed, in that which is essential to this Sacrament, we have already seen above from what has been confessed, p. 340. What remains of the disagreement, if it is weighed in an equal balance, will scarcely seem of so much importance.
pass_b_english: On what is essential to this sacrament, the Lutherans and the Reformed already agree; we saw that above from the confessed points (p. 340).
What is left of the quarrel, weighed fairly, will hardly seem worth so much.
source_text: Consensum Lutheranorum cum Reformatis, in eo quod essentiale est huic Sacramento, vidimus supra ex confessis, pag. 340. Quod reliquum est dissensionis, si aequa lance pendatur, vix tanti esse videbitur.

lemmas.gloss: what is essential to the sacrament

notes: Controv. print p. 67 / PDF ~168. Consensus on essentials (Protheoria confessis p. 340); remainder of dissent weighed as slight.

choices.english: what is essential to this sacrament
choices.why: Consensus already locked at Protheoria confessis p. 340; residual quarrel is adiaphora-weight

choices.english: weighed fairly / with an equal balance
choices.why: Literal scale metaphor; literary pass shortens without dropping the weighing claim
